meridian_human_host.guard.shield_raised: Your shield is up; no arm is free to guard
message.meridian_human_host.welcome.note: Cultivation begins with a scroll of Qi Meridian Notes: look in the chests of dungeons, abandoned mineshafts, desert pyramids and jungle temples; skeletons sometimes carry one. Right-click it, then press %s to open the cultivation page.
message.meridian_human_host.welcome.tech: Villagers, traders, pillagers, vindicators, evokers and witches all know techniques; defeat one yourself and it may drop a scroll of what it knew.
message.meridian_human_host.revival.expl: After respawning: every wound comes back only to one tenth and the rest heals slowly; your qi scattered at death, so breathe it in again; your muscles are spent and recover with rest. Meridians, realm and learned techniques are kept.
commands.meridian_human_host.target_not_: %s is not a player and has no human body
commands.meridian_human_host.qi.body: Body total %s yuan; meridian lumens %s yuan; walls %s yuan; in transit %s yuan.
%s is %s: a realm can only rise one step from Wandering Qi; the human body only reaches True Qi and cannot go back
Unknown realm: %s. Use wandering_qi or true_qi
